jobs.tierReason: the migration gate protects databases; new down modes must not weaken it
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/down-dir.diff and tools/migration-gate.mjs (new migrations down modes: "dir" with downDir, a separate folder for down files the Supabase CLI ignores, and "none", which skips only the down check; swarm init picks dir for supabase/migrations). Rules: (1) with dir, a down file is only valid at the mirrored path in downDir; a sibling .down.sql, a file outside downDir, a path with .. or a symlink must not satisfy the check; downDir can never be (or sit inside, or contain) the migrations dir; (2) none skips ONLY the down check: the destructive/privileged scan and the hash-bound approval must still run for every changed migration, in every path (check, queue check, approve command, round trip); (3) a change to a file in downDir must re-check its migration (and a deleted down file must not slip through); (4) isMigrationFile must never treat a down-folder file as a migration, and never treat a file in downDir as approved-by-proxy; (5) validateMigrationsConfig rejects bad combinations; init-profile validation keeps downDir; a profile written by older versions (sibling) still works; (6) path traversal / case-insensitive filesystem / Windows separators in downFileFor and upFileFor; (7) the test that models the Supabase CLI file rule is honest about being a model. Report each problem as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW with file, line and a concrete failing scenario, and say what you checked that is fine. Do not edit files.
